plugins.name: GGPK Explorer
plugins.author: POEFixer
plugins.description: Browses the game's content files: searchable file tree, viewers for tables, images, models and audio, and file extraction.
changes: Extracting folders and selections is several times faster (it reads whole bundles at once and writes with up to four threads), and a Cancel button in the toolbar stops a running extraction.
Save As converts textures to PNG and tables to JSON/CSV on several CPU cores, with its own Cancel button.
Find in Files, Replace in Files and Find references in the table viewer run much faster; replacing no longer freezes the window.
Expand All on a large folder no longer freezes the window.
Fixed crashes when loading, unloading or reloading (F5) during an extraction, export or search, and when a search used an invalid "\x" escape.
Folders with non-English names work for opening and extracting. Empty files are extracted, long output paths work, and failed writes are reported.
A file replaced with an empty one reads back correctly straight away, not only after the next save.
The replace preview no longer skips files inside collapsed folders.
The game path is pre-filled from the program's general settings when Smoother has none.
.aoc files open in the same Model view as meshes: the main model with its skeleton and animations. The Text tab is unchanged.
The 3D view is simpler: diffuse textures, one light, Solid/Wire, Grid, Bones, Follow and the animation panel. Lights, sounds, particles, states, sockets and attachments are removed.
The model view says what is missing (the mesh data, a parent of an .aoc, the skeleton) instead of showing an empty view, and saving an .aoc in the Text tab keeps the camera and the selected clip.
The Info tab shows a short summary with a Copy button.
Lighter: no shadow pass every frame, and the plugin DLL is about 15% smaller.

plugins.name: Tablet Reforge
plugins.author: v1sualxD, Omer Faruk ARPA, POEFixer
plugins.description: Runs the tablet reforge cycle: takes tablets from your stash, reforges trios at the Reforging Bench and puts the results back.
changes: First release maintained by POEFixer, adopted from v1sualxD's Tablet Reforge 1.1.0. Thank you, @v1sualxD, for the plugin and the whole stash-to-bench cycle.
Now part of the POEFixer plugin catalog: install and update it from the Plugin Manager.
Works with every game client language: the Reforging Bench, the Tablets subtab and Sanctified tablets are found by the game's own texts in the client's language.
When the Fragment stash tab shows another subtab (Fragments, Trials), the cycle selects its Tablets subtab itself; when it cannot find the button, the status line asks you to select it.
New setting "Tablet stash tab": the name of the stash tab that holds your tablets; empty picks a tab named like Tablets, else one named like Fragments.
The plugin's texts follow the POEFixer program language (ten languages).

New settings tab in the POEFixer style: the Start button and the status line at the top, cards for categories, withdrawal and keep filters, a tooltip on every control, the transfer speed explained with the pause and click length it gives, a clear warning that the return step moves every item of your bag, and Diagnostics like in the other POEFixer plugins.
A new install ticks no category, so the first Start never withdraws every tablet at once.

Safer input: at the stash the cycle lets go of Ctrl and the mouse button when the game loses focus; when you come back it never repeats an interrupted click but selects the stash page again and checks the tablet again before any click on the stash (a withdrawal that may have reached the game is only confirmed from your bag); at the Reforging Bench a focus loss stops it (take any tablets left in the bench); the time away does not count against a click still being confirmed. It stops when the mouse is moved during a click or while a tablet is checked, or when an item is held on the cursor.
The cycle can no longer wait forever: repeated stash, bench and tab clicks stop after 8 tries, and a step that waits for something that never shows stops after 20 seconds with a line naming it.
The POEFixer window is never minimized when it also shows the in-game overlay; the cycle asks you to close the menu instead.
The status window shows in game only while a cycle runs and for a few seconds after it ends, and it never catches the cycle's own clicks.

Your clipboard is put back after a tablet's text was checked, only over the game's copy of that tablet: also when the cycle stops in the moment the game copies, when you switch away from the game right after the copy, when the game copies late (up to 5 seconds after, also after a stop), or when a clipboard history holds the clipboard open for a moment. Anything else, what another program copied or an item you copy yourself in the game, is kept.

A stash tablet is Ctrl-clicked only when a reading of the game taken after its Sanctified check shows its page on screen with the same tablet in the checked cell, so a page the game switched late is never clicked into. Two pages that hold the same cells are never mistaken for each other, also when the page changed while the game was in the background.
The stash discovery file is written only during a debug recording.

Tablets already in your bag at Start go back to the stash first, also when the cycle opens the stash itself; the scan takes the eligible ones out again with the Sanctified check every stash tablet gets, so a Sanctified tablet in your bag is never reforged. The settings tab says so.

A withdrawal and a bench transfer must move exactly the chosen tablet (the same mods and values), not merely one of the same kind; a changed stack or tablet in the bag is noticed. A tablet's mods are read again before it is taken and when a result arrives, never taken from another item that was in the same place before.
A tablet found Sanctified by its tooltip or text stays excluded for the whole cycle, and a result of the cycle is never reforged again in the same cycle.

Clicks land only in Path of Exile 2: a POEFixer window or another program under the cursor stops the cycle without a click; so does Ctrl, Shift, Alt, the Windows key or any mouse button held during a click (other keys are not checked). A click on the stash or the bench in the world reads the mouse, the keys and the window under the cursor again right before its button goes down, after the stash or the bench was found again.

A click on a stash category, page or tablet goes down only while that control is still shown where the cycle found it, and a click on a stash tab only while the stash is open and that tab is still under the cursor; after the return step the stash controls are found again, so a click never lands on another subtab's items.

An item held on the mouse cursor is detected at Start, before every click on the stash or the bench in the world, before the first click once the stash or the bench has opened or the game is back after a pause, and after every tablet moved.

A click on the stash or the bench in the world waits while your inventory is open, so it cannot land on an item there; it goes down only once fresh readings show the inventory closed and the stash or the bench still under the cursor. It also waits while the passive skill tree, the game menu or the character panel is open; the status line says to close them with their own key or button, since Esc stops the cycle.
Another POEFixer automation that starts during the cycle stops it at once.

The Sanctified check trusts only the hovered tablet's own tooltip, one that appeared after the cursor reached it: a text already on screen, the stash window (category labels, tab names), the chat and the stash's labels in any game language never stand for it. "Not Sanctified" needs two agreeing looks at the tooltip and no Sanctified line anywhere in the game interface, and a look that could not read the whole interface (a text too long to read included) never decides. A Sanctified word elsewhere on screen (a chat line, a stash tab name, an item on the ground) never marks a tablet Sanctified by itself. Otherwise the copied text decides, only when it is the game's own copy of that tablet with its rarity line; when that cannot decide either, the tablet stays in the stash.

A tablet whose mods cannot be read correctly (an identified Magic or Rare tablet without any prefix or suffix, or with more than it can have, as when POEFixer does not read a new game version correctly yet) is never taken: it stays in the stash and the cycle stops with a line naming it, instead of ignoring the mods you keep.
The clipboard is left alone when it holds more than 8 MB or a format that cannot be put back; the cycle stops instead of copying the tablet text.
Esc stops the cycle only when you press it, never from the Esc the cycle sends itself, and a quick press right after the cycle's own Esc still counts.
Much lighter on the frame rate: nothing is read while no cycle runs, each tablet's mods are read once, and the stash page and tooltip are searched only where needed.
A POEFixer older than 366 is told so at Start instead of running a cycle that cannot see the stash.
Settings are saved once you stop changing them, not on every frame of a slider; a change made just before enabling the plugin or quitting is kept.
A saved keep mod that this version's mod list does not know keeps its category's tablets in the stash instead of protecting nothing; the Keep filters card names it and can remove it.

A mod on a tablet that the Keep filters card does not offer keeps that tablet in the stash while its category has keep mods selected, instead of taking a tablet whose kept mod now reads under another name. A mod the game no longer rolls (an old tablet) just keeps it; for a mod the game data of this version does not have (a game patch renamed or added it) the cycle stops with a line naming the mod.
The keep rule is exactly what the Keep filters card shows: a required-mod group or value range from a copied Tablet Helper settings file is not applied.
Inventory readings the cycle asks for are asked for again when another plugin's scan pushes them aside, so busy plugins no longer make the cursor checks time out.

Holding a key or a mouse button during the stash scan no longer makes the plugin search the game interface on every frame, and neither does a click on the stash that waits for a game panel to close or a key to be released.
A full bag without tablets of the cycle now stops with "no free cell", not with a missing trio.
